description: Compute real transits to a natal chart over a date window, from NASA JPL DE440S ephemerides with Skyfield. Takes the same birth parameters as compute_natal_chart plus a start and end date, and returns the transiting body, the natal body it aspects, the aspect, the orb and the UTC instant of each hit. The window is capped at 90 days (about four months) and longer windows are sampled more coarsely, so this is a forecast timeline, not minute-precise event timing. Computation can take up to a minute for long windows. The natal foundation and transit scan are computed in memory; this tool does not create a person or save a report.

city.description: Human-readable birth place label, for display only.

end.description: Last day of the transit window, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 90 days after start.

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

locale.description: Language for the returned free-chart link. Defaults to en.

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

start.description: First day of the transit window, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: Local birth time at the birth place, 24-hour HH:MM.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birth place, e.g. "Europe/Madrid". Required — a wrong zone moves the Ascendant and every house cusp.

name: compute_transits
title: Compute transits
